faqs.q: Sec. 59-5. - Municipal lien not exclusive method of collection.
faqs.a:
The procedure contained in this chapter is not intended to establish an exclusive
               method for collection of amounts owed to the city, and nothing contained herein shall
               preclude the city from pursuing other methods of collection, including but not limited
               to judicial foreclosure of municipal liens. Such liens may be foreclosed upon by the
               city at any time in the same manner as provided by the laws of the state for judicial
               foreclosure of municipal liens.
(
Ord. No. 4042, § 1, 12-11-2006
)
